name: Tossable Digits
summary: Virtual phone numbers in the US, Canada and many other countries that forward calls to your own phone and send personal text messages, billed monthly or yearly.
best_for: expats, travelers and individuals who want to keep or park a US or Canadian number and forward calls and personal texts to their own phone cheaply
skip_if: you need business texting or a full business phone system with teams, call routing and CRM links, or you need SMS on numbers outside the US and Canada
honest_knock: Unlimited SMS is for personal, person-to-person conversations only; the page states that business-related outgoing SMS is not allowed and that SMS from outside the US and Canada is not supported. Included minutes cover calls forwarded to US or Canada numbers only, and international forwarding is billed at separate rates. Annual plans get no pro-rated refund.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-08 on tossabledigits.com/pricing, US dollars) Tossable Digits, run by Telusion, Inc., sells virtual phone numbers that forward calls and send text messages, billed monthly or annually. Month to month there is a pay-as-you-go option at $3.49 per number and $0.12 per minute with nothing included, then Basic at $7 (1 number, 60 minutes), Advanced at $19 (3 numbers, 400 minutes) and Professional at $39 (7 numbers, 1,000 minutes). Annual plans are Lite at $40 a year (1 number, 25 minutes a month), Basic at $80 (2 numbers, 75 minutes), Advanced at $209 (3 numbers, 400 minutes) and Professional at $429 (7 numbers, 1,000 minutes). Extra US or Canada numbers cost $3.49, $2.99, $2.19 or $1.49 a month and extra minutes $0.12, $0.10, $0.07 or $0.04, falling as the plan goes up. Included numbers, minutes and SMS apply to US and Canadian numbers only; numbers in other countries are billed monthly outside the plans, from $3.99 a month for many countries up to $46.99 for Saint Martin. US toll-free numbers are available but not included, and toll-free SMS costs $0.02 per message. The page says pro-rated refunds are not provided on annual plans. Account creation and checkout were not tested by us.

compare_with.name: CallHippo
compare_with.why: CallHippo is a business phone system with teams and call features, billed per user. Tossable Digits is closer to a number you keep and forward. Compare it with a business system only if all you need is the number; if you need business SMS or team features, the SMS rule above rules it out.
